stemMd: A class has 12 students. In how many ways can a captain and a different deputy be selected?
explanationMd: Choose the captain in twelve ways and the deputy from the remaining eleven. The roles are distinct, so order matters: 12×11=132. Dividing by two would incorrectly identify swapped roles.

distractorRationale.b: This treats the two roles as an unordered pair.
distractorRationale.e: This allows the same student to fill both roles.
distractorRationale.a: This doubles the class size instead of multiplying the twelve captain choices by eleven distinct deputy choices.
distractorRationale.c: This incorrectly removes two students before choosing the deputy.
